name: NonCanonical
description: object or header is not the deterministic RFC 8949 §4.2.1 encoding (non-minimal, indefinite-length, unsorted or duplicate keys, a float, or the 0x41A0 empty header)

name: DepthExceeded
description: CBOR nesting depth exceeds the maximum (§3.4)

name: Malformed
description: structurally malformed object or COSE structure (the generic fallback rejection)

name: ContentIdMismatch
description: the recomputed content id does not equal the carried content id (§2.3)

name: HeaderBodyMismatch
description: a protected-header routing copy disagrees with the signed body (§2.6)

name: UnsupportedVersion
description: the protected-header naalp-version is not supported (§2.5.3)

name: UnknownCriticalExt
description: a critical-extension (cext) key is not understood (§2.5)

name: UnknownKind
description: the channel/kind code is not a registered surface (§3.2)

name: RangeError
description: a field value is outside its permitted range

name: NonNFC
description: a text field is not in Unicode Normalization Form C (§3.1)

name: WrongAudience
description: the signed audience is not the verifying party (§2.5.3, R1)

name: TooLarge
description: the object exceeds the maximum octet size (§3.4)

name: TooManyCauses
description: causes[] exceeds the maximum count (§3.4)

name: TooManyExtensions
description: the ext or cext map exceeds the maximum cardinality (§3.4)

name: TooManyChunks
description: a stream presents more chunks than the maximum (§3.4, §10)

name: UnknownAlg
description: the algorithm id is not in the N-AALP signature registry (§4)

name: KeyAlgMismatch
description: the key algorithm does not match the object header (§4.5)

name: ProfileDowngrade
description: the signature level is below the profile minimum (§4.5)

name: HybridIncomplete
description: a hybrid/composite object has a component signature that does not verify (§4.5)

name: SuiteMismatch
description: the signed suite declaration disagrees with the signature alg or structure (§4.5)

name: CompositeRefused
description: a Sovereign verifier refuses a composite (non-pure) object (§4.5)

name: BadSignature
description: signature verification failed (§4)

name: SignerMismatch
description: the recomputed signer id does not equal the key, or a revocation signer is neither the key nor a configured recovery key (§5.1, §5.3, §5.5)

name: RotationUnauthorized
description: a rotation object is not co-signed by both the old and new keys, or is presented as a single-signature object (§5.2)

name: KeyRevoked
description: the signing key is revoked as of the object's authoritative receipt position (§5.3)

name: EffectNotAuthorized
description: the declared effect is not authorized for the principal (§6)

description: an effecting object requires an approval and none was presented (§7)

name: ApprovalExpired
description: the approval's validity window has passed (§7)

name: AlreadyConsumed
description: a consume-once object was already consumed (§7)

name: ConsumeFork
description: two consume receipts fork the single-consume ledger (§7)

name: ConsumeForkInvalid
description: a presented consume-fork proof is not a valid fork (§7)

name: ConsumeReceiptUnsigned
description: a consume receipt is not signed (§7)

description: the consume ledger is structurally corrupt (§7)

description: a consume-ledger record is not signed (§7)

name: RefusalDetailLeak
description: a coarse-refusal object discloses detail beyond the coarse vocabulary (R-TDCS-3)

description: an audit or hash-chain link does not verify (§8)

description: two conflicting signed statements occupy one chain position (§8)

description: an authoritative receipt is not signed (§8)

description: an audit fork proof is not one signer over two conflicting objects (§8)

description: a stream commit digest does not equal the recomputed rolling digest (§10)

description: a streaming event is illegal for the current stream state (§10 state table)

description: the transport peer is not authenticated (§12)
